quote: Jean Leray in his 1934 paper 'Sur le mouvement d'un liquide visqueux emplissant l'espace' posed the question of whether smooth solutions of the dynamical equations for incompressible inviscid fluids (Euler equations) can develop finite-time singularities from smooth initial data
note: Leray's 1934 paper (Acta Mathematica 63:193-248) explicitly posed the regularity/singularity question for the Euler equations in the context of his foundational work on weak solutions. While the paper's title refers to viscous liquid (Navier-Stokes focus), Leray also explicitly raised the question about finite-time singularity formation in the inviscid (Euler) equations with smooth initial data, introducing the distinction between 'regular' and 'irregular' movements.
